query: Script the DevFees feature video and give me a shot list so an editor can start.
expected_behavior: Pulls the video request / CCAL ticket and pins down purpose, audience, and key message before writing
Produces a production-ready brief plus a script/voiceover and a shot list an editor can work straight from
Points downstream to the production chain (Rough Cut -> GFX -> Color -> Sound -> Deliverables) and to remotion-narrated-film for generated/narrated explainers
Produces copy with no em dashes (Facilitron voice)

Before drafting, resolves an explicit Drive or Confluence destination plus review state, owner, and approver; success returns the exact durable URL and all target surface, Jira, asset, and website handoff metadata
Uses one unique scratch workspace, removes it on success and failure, and never branches, opens a worktree, writes repository content, commits, or opens a PR
Stays git-free: it plans, editing happens in the NLE
